text:
alex.kim: heads up — saw clients reattaching to a different model shard after a short network flap but console says 'resumed' and billing shows two sessions charged :confused:

maya: ugh. do you have a minimal repro or logs? which headers are in the resume?

alex.kim: attaching the snippet from ingress logs (sanitized):
```
POST /sse/resume 200
x-resume-id: 7f3a2c
x-session-latch: true
x-route-id: shard-12
user-agent: RedwoodSDK/1.4.2
```
The client then gets proxied to shard-07 on the next attach. latency spike + health probe routed it elsewhere.

cheng: sounds like sticky routing + ephemeral resume tokens are out of sync. we treat `x-route-id` as advisory after reconnect, but the client latch header forces sticky routing on the server side — race there.

jamie: can we make the console show both the client-declared route and the actual backend route on the session timeline? right now console only shows the last successful backend. that hides the mismatch.

maya: agree. telemetry-wise we also lose the finalization span if the client reconnects quickly — our billing job sees both sessions as active for overlap and invoices twice. we need a canonical session end event emitted by the proxy even if resume happens.

ops-bot: [alert] sse-session-latch-detected: 2034567890 shard-mismatch count=14 window=5m :eyes:

alex.kim: proposal: 1) emit `session.transition` span with fields `{prev_route, next_route, reason}` at reconnect; 2) server should reject resume if route mismatch and require explicit `resume-override=true` from client; 3) console: surface `route_mismatch` badge on session view.

cheng: implementation note: rejecting resume by default avoids double-charge but could break customer flows. alternative: accept resume but mark `is_latched=false` and route to next, then emit a `latch_broken` event so billing can reconcile.

jamie: UX tradeoff — rejecting is safer for billing but will increase resume failures for clients that expect seamless resume across shards. If we go with reject, we need a clear SDK change and a console migration banner.

maya: for telemetry fix I can add a finalization hook in proxy that emits `session.close` with `reason=resume` before reestablishing. small patch: 
```diff
+ emit_span("session.close", {session_id, reason: "resume", prev_route})
+ allow_resume_if(resume_token && resume_token.route == prev_route)
```
That should collapse overlapping billing windows.

alex.kim: +1 to the finalization hook. jamie please sketch an inbox message for customers if we change resume semantics. cheng, can you prototype the `session.transition` span shape? we need it in logs -> console pipeline.

deploy-bot: deploy queued: patch/telemetry-session-finalizer -> staging (sha: d7f9b3)

maya: testing on staging now. will post a short repro script if it reliably reproduces the overlap.

jamie: I'll draft a short console banner and docs blurb: "Resumes that cross routing boundaries will require explicit confirmation or may appear as a new session; see logs for `route_mismatch` events."

alex.kim: thanks. tagging @security because this affects how we annotate customer session boundaries for audit logs.

ops-bot: [note] follow-up: create a dashboard panel 'sse route_mismatch' and alert at >10/m sustained.

maya: test update — staging shows session.close emitted, billing overlap reduced in preliminary runs. will run longer sanity overnight.

cheng: next: decide reject vs accept-with-mark. leaning toward accept-with-mark to avoid breaking older SDKs, and rely on console + billing reconciliation to be the single source of truth.

alex.kim: ok let's converge tomorrow after longer staging run. thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
